blockingIssues.featureName: Expand integrations pages for Starlight docs site
blockingIssues.description: Lines 106-107 in openapi-and-plugins.md document 'foxctl cache clear --type=openapi_spec'. This command does not exist at any level. Verified: './bin/foxctl cache --help' → 'unknown command "cache" for "foxctl"'. Note: 'foxctl memory cache' is a different subcommand (verb: 'Fetch a cached result by cache key') — not the same as what the docs describe.
blockingIssues.suggestedFix: Remove 'foxctl cache clear' references, or replace with 'foxctl memory cache <key>' if the intent is to fetch a cached result. Also check docs/spec/openapi_skill.md for the same phantom command references.

nonBlockingIssues.description: Lines 91 and 100 reference 'foxctl openapi import --strict' and 'foxctl openapi validate --strict'. The --strict flag was not verified to exist. Run 'foxctl openapi import --help' and 'foxctl openapi validate --help' to confirm.
Blackboard agent commands may need coverage in protocol-v1.md. Cross-check against 'foxctl room --help' and 'foxctl blackboard --help' if the blackboard subcommand exists.

verdict.summary: 2 of 5 features have blocking issues. expand-integrations: phantom 'foxctl cache clear' command documented (does not exist). expand-storage-and-reference: fabricated 'legacy/' directory listed in archive table. Remaining 3 features pass all assertions.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add guidance to verify CLI commands via './bin/foxctl <command> --help' before documenting them
Consider adding a rule: verify filesystem directory existence (via ls) before listing them in archive/directory structure tables
Document foxctl memory cache as the subcommand for fetching cached results by key (verb: 'Fetch a cached result by cache key') — distinct from top-level cache operations
